prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup / ui-mockup. Create a single premium WEBSITE CARD ILLUSTRATION asset for PhoneBridger. The supplied image is a STYLE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE only, showing a six-card section; do not reproduce the section. Output ONLY the requested visual, no outer card border, no card number, no marketing headline, no CTA button, no caption. Wide 3:2 canvas, high resolution approximately 1536x1024. Beautiful coherent near-black charcoal, warm subtle pink #ff279b accent lighting, realistic black devices and crisp simplified English UI. Fully visible subject, 6% clear margin on all sides. Frontal product presentation, gentle depth and realistic material detail, sharp silhouettes. True transparent alpha outside the complete object composition with a soft natural shadow under the objects. No opaque rectangular backdrop, no checkerboard baked in, no random props, no watermark. All object components belong to ONE integrated asset, not separate individual objects. Match the polished visual language of the reference, slightly more detailed and refined. No tiny illegible filler text. Windows styling on any desktop interface, never macOS traffic-light buttons. Requested asset 01 MOVE BETWEEN SCREENS: one elegant black Microsoft Surface-style laptop on the left and one slim black Android phone standing on the right. Both show matching dark abstract flowing pink wallpaper. Laptop has a neat Windows 11 taskbar, no app menus or text. Phone only minimal tiny status symbols and white gesture bar. A restrained dotted pink arc crosses from the right edge of laptop display to the left edge of the phone, and a single small beautifully crisp white pointer emerges at the phone's screen edge. Do not put a second cursor on the PC. Laptop, keyboard and entire phone all fit inside canvas, nothing clipped. The route is short and natural, not a huge arch. No whole desk backdrop.
